title: ID0466065-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / R5 170002027] Dispenser doesnt boot
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Dispenser out of order. Dispenser PLC doesnt boot. After dispenser power cycle, dispenser doesnt boot and is blinking red LEDs.
See video in the timeline.
Solution: TB210 replaced after dispenser PLC was replaced.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0466065-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / R5 170002027] Dispenser doesnt boot CRM:03055000415
additional_info.body:
Dear Markus,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0466065
for dispenser. I checked your video, and to me it seems there is a problem with the AC power supply to the dispenser or DC power supply.
From your video, I can see that, when turning on FB201:
The PLC is powered on (even though several LEDs are red)
The fuses FC212, 213 and 214 are off
As a consequence, all 24V powered components are off
In order to identify the issue, it is necessary to go onsite and verify:
If QA210 is closing or not
If QA210 is not closing, to force the closing
If DC voltage pure supply TB210 is powered on by AC, and if it is producing 24V volt stable
If TB210 is producing 24V, press FC212 to see if works or not
Based on the findings, it will be necessary to maybe replace some components. I would recommend, if possible, to already go onsite with a QA210 and TB210 which, based on the video, I believe might be the cause of the issue.
Therefore, I am moving the case
0466065
﻿from the Technical Support to the
eMobility RC-FI SI E Queue.
We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FI SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
